description: This file defines the UserService interface, extending SalesManagerEntityService, specifying methods for user management such as retrieving users by username, listing users, creating/updating users, and listing users by merchant store.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service interface for user-related operations in the application, extending generic entity service for Long-User entities.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all users.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates a new user or updates an existing user's information.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users associated with a specific merchant store.
